about_the_game:
Off the Beaten Track is a chaotic multiplayer arcade action game where absurd flying machines, unpredictable physics, and insane weapons turn every match into pure madness.

Play locally or online with up to 4 players, battle across cosmic arenas, and let the chaos decide the outcome — because nothing ever goes as planned.

Whether you're here for casual party fun or sweaty competitive showdowns, Off the Beaten Track delivers fast, frantic matches packed with close calls, ridiculous moments, and unforgettable victories. Easy to pick up but hard to master, every fight rewards skill, reflexes, and quick thinking.

Key Features

  • Local & Online Multiplayer for up to 4 players

  • 14 quirky animal pilots, each with their own personality

  • 56+ insane weapons — rockets, lasers, mines, and more

  • 14+ interactive arenas, including secret ones

  • Accessible arcade controls with real skill-based depth

  • Perfect for party nights, rivalries, and rematches
